title: Output Contract + Error Infrastructure + Global Settings
description: Implement the central IOutputWriter interface, JsonOutputWriter (production), InMemoryOutputWriter (tests), ZapiCliException with typed error codes, GlobalSettings for global flags, and wire up Program.cs with the CommandApp. This establishes the no-wrapper JSON output contract that every command in the project must use.
prerequisiteState: Story 1 complete. Three-project solution compiles. IKeychainProvider and all implementations exist. Program.cs is a stub.
goal: Every command can call IOutputWriter.WriteJson / WriteRaw / WriteError and get deterministic JSON on stdout/stderr respectively. The CommandApp is wired, global flags are parsed, and unhandled exceptions are converted to the error envelope on stderr.
scope: Create src/ZapiCli.Core/IOutputWriter.cs with interface: void WriteJson(object data), void WriteRaw(string rawJson), void WriteError(string message, string code, int exitCode = 1)

Create src/ZapiCli.Core/JsonOutputWriter.cs implementing IOutputWriter: WriteJson serializes with System.Text.Json + JsonNamingPolicy.SnakeCaseLower and writes to Console.Out; WriteRaw writes the raw string to Console.Out as-is (no serialization); WriteError serializes the error envelope { error, code, exitCode } with camelCase and writes to Console.Error. Both use no trailing newline beyond what Console.WriteLine adds.

Create src/ZapiCli.Core/InMemoryOutputWriter.cs implementing IOutputWriter: thread-safe, stores all WriteJson/WriteRaw calls in List<string> SuccessOutput and WriteError calls in List<ErrorRecord> Errors. Expose LastSuccessJson, AllSuccessJson, LastError, AllErrors for test assertions.
Create src/ZapiCli.Core/ZapiCliException.cs: public sealed class ZapiCliException(string message, string code, int exitCode = 1) : Exception(message). Properties: Code (string), ExitCode (int).

Create src/ZapiCli.Core/ErrorCodes.cs: public static class ErrorCodes with static readonly string constants for all error codes: ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND, ACCOUNT_ALREADY_EXISTS, NO_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT, AUTH_FAILURE, NEEDS_REAUTH, API_ERROR, INVALID_ARGS, IO_ERROR, KEYCHAIN_ERROR, ACCOUNT_DOMAIN_BLOCKED, EMAIL_REQUIRED, HOST_NOT_ALLOWED, INTERNAL_ERROR.

Create src/ZapiCli/Commands/GlobalSettings.cs: public class GlobalSettings : CommandSettings with [CommandOption("--account")] string? Account, [CommandOption("--json")] bool Json = true (default), [CommandOption("--no-input")] bool NoInput = false. All sub-command settings classes must inherit GlobalSettings.

Update src/ZapiCli/Program.cs: create CommandApp, configure DI via DependencyInjectionRegistrar, register JsonOutputWriter as IOutputWriter singleton, register IHttpClientFactory (services.AddHttpClient()), intercept args == ["--version"] before CommandApp to print AssemblyInformationalVersion and return 0, wrap CommandApp.RunAsync in try/catch for ZapiCliException (write error envelope, return exitCode) and catch Exception (write INTERNAL_ERROR envelope, return 1), handle OperationCanceledException (exit 1 silently).

Add Spectre.Console.Cli NuGet package to ZapiCli.csproj, Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection to ZapiCli.Core.csproj, Microsoft.Extensions.Logging + Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Console to ZapiCli.Core.csproj.
Configure logging in Program.cs: LogToStandardErrorThreshold = LogLevel.Trace so Warning+ logs go to stderr only (never to stdout where JSON output lives).

Write unit tests in ZapiCli.Tests/OutputWriterTests.cs: WriteJson serializes with snake_case; WriteRaw passes raw string through unchanged; WriteError produces correct { error, code, exitCode } envelope; ErrorCodes constants are all non-null non-empty strings.
acceptanceCriteria: dotnet build succeeds with 0 errors and 0 warnings
IOutputWriter is in ZapiCli.Core namespace with exactly WriteJson, WriteRaw, WriteError signatures
JsonOutputWriter.WriteRaw('{"raw":1}') → stdout contains '{"raw":1}' with no re-serialization
InMemoryOutputWriter.WriteJson records to SuccessOutput; InMemoryOutputWriter.WriteError records to Errors
ZapiCliException carries Code and ExitCode accessible as properties
ErrorCodes.ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND, AUTH_FAILURE, HOST_NOT_ALLOWED etc. are non-null string constants
GlobalSettings has --account, --json, and --no-input options with correct defaults
Program.cs catches ZapiCliException and writes error envelope to stderr with the exception's ExitCode
Program.cs catches unhandled Exception and writes INTERNAL_ERROR envelope to stderr with exit 1
Program.cs intercepts --version before CommandApp and outputs AssemblyInformationalVersion
contextForAgent: The no-wrapper output contract is critical. WriteJson must NOT wrap in { status, data } — it serializes the data object directly. WriteRaw is for passing Zoho API response bodies through byte-for-byte. WriteError always goes to stderr. Read ADR-0008 for the full output contract rationale. IMPORTANT: logging (ILogger) must go to stderr via LogToStandardErrorThreshold — never to stdout. Commands must NEVER call Console.Write() or Console.WriteLine() directly — always go through IOutputWriter. InMemoryOutputWriter must be placed in ZapiCli.Core (not the test project) so all future test stories can inject it without adding project references.

openItems.defaultAssumption: Create a shared internal static readonly JsonSerializerOptions in JsonOutputWriter with PropertyNamingPolicy = JsonNamingPolicy.SnakeCaseLower, WriteIndented = false, DefaultIgnoreCondition = JsonIgnoreCondition.WhenWritingNull. Reuse the same options for all WriteJson calls.

The error envelope uses camelCase keys: { "error": "...", "code": "...", "exitCode": N }. Note 'exitCode' is camelCase, not 'exit_code'. Use [JsonPropertyName("exitCode")] attribute on the ExitCode property of the error envelope record to override the SnakeCaseLower policy.
